ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approx. 1:12 ratio of high-intensity to low-intensity pixels; the visible surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity highlights localized at the tips and edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity (black/dark-gray) field across the majority of the fluke surface area. High-intensity (white) geometric clusters are localized at the distal tips [Left distal terminal, Right distal terminal] and along the serrated trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 45 degrees; vertical depth occupies approximately 25% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across both lobes; pixel-amplitude of variations ranges from 3-10 pixels; density of peaks increases significantly toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curvature on both lobes; the sweep trajectory transitions from near-horizontal at the median notch to near-vertical at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense, high-contrast, multi-pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; secondary clusters of high-intensity points along the mid-trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear disruptions of lighter pixel intensity visible against the dark background of the mid-left and mid-right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large protuberant structural growths at both distal tips; distinct, deep irregular notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately 30% distance from the median notch.
